name: 800G passive copper cable (DAC)
summary: Passive direct-attach copper cable for in-rack and adjacent-rack 800G links.

reachM.note: IEEE 802.3ck 100 Gb/s-per-lane copper targets 2 m; some vendors ship 2.5–3 m with thicker gauge.

powerWPerEnd.note: Passive cable; only the identification EEPROM draws power.

capexUsdPerM.note: Judgment: a 2 m 800G DAC sells for roughly 100–200 USD.
